rec.name: Shop the Look Info (Image Hotspot Section)
rec.status: Built — client-approved, documented (Slite doc + source ZIP)

what.text: A custom Shopify section, "CRO | Shop the Look Info", that shows a large image on a colored or gradient background with a heading, short text and a pill CTA button (e.g. "Learn more"). Pulsing white "+" hotspot dots sit on top of the image. On desktop, clicking a dot opens an info card next to it. On mobile, it opens a bottom-sheet card with a title and short text, and the dot turns into an "x". The section works when duplicated several times on one page.

why.text: Hotspots turn a static lifestyle or product image into something to explore. The pulsing dots invite interaction and let shoppers pick the details that interest them (curiosity and self-directed discovery) without leaving the page. Feature callouts such as materials or benefits are shown at the moment of attention, which builds perceived value before the shopper reaches the product page. The ticket also aims to show products with price, rating and add-to-cart next to the look, which would shorten the path to purchase, but the built version does not do this.

how.text: 1) Create the section file `ed-cro-shop-the-look-info.liquid` and paste in the provided code, which includes inline CSS, Liquid and a small JS modal controller. 2) In the theme editor, add "CRO | Shop the Look Info" to a template. 3) Set the heading, text, button text and link. 4) Upload the desktop image and an optional mobile image. 5) Pick the background color or gradient. 6) Add one "Item" block per hotspot. Enter its heading and text, and set Left % and Top % to place the dot on the image. Desktop shows the card inline next to the dot and toggles it on click. Mobile (≤999px) shows a bottom sheet with an overlay and locks page scroll. The pulse is a CSS keyframe animation on the dot's ::after element. The JS is scoped per section, so duplicates don't conflict.

items: Section background color and background gradient
Text/heading color (falls back to the theme color)
Heading title, heading text, heading font size (desktop and mobile)
Content font size and button font size (desktop and mobile)
Button text and link (button is hidden if the text is empty)
Section width (container class) and optional custom max-width
Spacing top/bottom/left/right (separate desktop and mobile values)
Hotspot blocks ("Item"): heading, text, position left % and position top %

dependencies.text: No metafields (ticket flag MF/N). Assumes an Impact-style theme with the `.container`, `.button` and `.h5` classes and theme color settings. Needs a `cursor-close.svg` theme asset for the mobile overlay cursor. The JS is bundled in the section, and the source ZIP is attached to the ticket. The code file is truncated in the source, so the full JS could not be checked. The ticket references a Shopify Impact theme (Sound style) as inspiration.

items: Scroll depth and engagement time on the section
Click-through to PDP/collection from the page
Conversion rate and revenue per session for exposed vs. control

images.caption: Desktop: heading, text and pill CTA on the left, product image on an olive gradient with three pulsing white "+" hotspots.
Mobile in the theme customizer: heading and CTA above the image, an opened hotspot (shown as "x") and a bottom-sheet card with title and text.
Section picker entry "CRO | Shop the Look Info" with its preview and the Item blocks listed in the section tree.
